en.summary: This commit fixes RV64 floating-point writeback formatting by NaN-boxing 32-bit FPU results before they are written into 64-bit registers.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says it fixes FPU bugs on 64-bit systems.
The patch changes FPU result packaging in three hardware units.
NaN-boxing of narrow FP results is an architectural correctness requirement on RV64, not a cosmetic formatting issue.
evidence: VX_fpu_div.sv, VX_fpu_fma.sv, and VX_fpu_sqrt.sv all change the final result assignment.
The new logic writes {32'hffffffff, low32} when XLEN > 32 instead of forwarding a raw 32-bit payload into the 64-bit destination.
The patch comment explicitly cites the RISC-V requirement that upper bits be all ones for NaN-boxed F32 results in 64-bit registers.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: On a 64-bit ISA that stores single-precision results in 64-bit FP registers, a 32-bit result must be NaN-boxed: the upper half of the destination register must be all ones. If a floating-point unit writes only the raw low 32-bit payload and leaves the upper bits zero, stale, or undefined, later FP operations can treat the register as an improperly boxed value and produce architectural mismatches.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A 32-bit floating-point operation completes on a machine whose architectural FP register width is wider than 32 bits.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Write the low 32-bit result into the destination register without forcing the upper bits to all ones.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: omit NaN boxing on narrow FP results
portability_notes: Map this to any RV64-like or mixed-width FP design that reuses wider architectural registers for narrower FP formats.
The low 32-bit arithmetic result can remain correct; the bug lives entirely in the packing/writeback stage.
Injecting this into one unit reproduces a narrower bug; injecting it into all narrow-result units reproduces the original broader defect.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the final result-pack stage for 32-bit FP operations before register-file writeback.
Replace NaN-boxing with a plain low-32-bit assignment into the wider destination register.
Leave FP exception flags and the actual 32-bit arithmetic datapath unchanged.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: final F32 result packing on RV64 FPU paths
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes each module to emit {32'hffffffff, result[31:0]} when XLEN > 32 so single-precision results are NaN-boxed in 64-bit registers.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the old direct assignment from data_out to result so the upper 32 bits are no longer forced to all ones on XLEN > 32.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Single-precision FP results written on a 64-bit machine become improperly boxed, causing architectural mismatches and downstream FP interpretation errors.
evidence_for_injection: All three affected modules change only the result packing logic, not the arithmetic cores.
The fix explicitly targets the XLEN > 32 case, which isolates the bug to 64-bit writeback formatting.
notes: Applying the mutation to only one module is useful for a smaller fault-injection benchmark; the original commit fixed all three in parallel.

zh.summary: 该提交通过在 32 位 FPU 结果写入 64 位寄存器前执行 NaN-boxing，修复了 RV64 浮点写回格式错误。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明修复的是 64 位系统上的 FPU 缺陷。
补丁修改了三个硬件 FPU 单元的结果打包逻辑。
在 RV64 上对窄浮点结果进行 NaN-boxing 是体系结构正确性要求，不是表面格式问题。
evidence: VX_fpu_div.sv、VX_fpu_fma.sv 和 VX_fpu_sqrt.sv 都修改了最终结果赋值。
新逻辑在 XLEN > 32 时写入 {32'hffffffff, low32}，而不是把原始 32 位 payload 直接塞进 64 位目的寄存器。
补丁注释明确提到：对于 64 位寄存器中的 F32 结果，RISC-V 要求高位全 1。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在使用 64 位 FP 寄存器来承载单精度结果的 64 位 ISA 中，32 位结果必须经过 NaN-boxing：目的寄存器高半部分必须全为 1。如果浮点单元只写入原始低 32 位 payload，而让高位保持为 0、旧值或未定义，那么后续浮点操作就可能把该寄存器视为错误封箱值，从而产生体系结构不一致。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一个 32 位浮点操作在体系结构 FP 寄存器宽度大于 32 位的机器上完成。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把低 32 位结果直接写入目的寄存器，而不把高位强制为全 1。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: omit NaN boxing on narrow FP results
portability_notes: 可映射到任何类似 RV64、且用更宽架构寄存器承载更窄浮点格式的设计。
低 32 位算术结果本身可以保持正确；故障完全位于打包/写回阶段。
只对一个单元注入会得到更窄的缺陷；对所有窄结果单元都注入则更接近原始问题覆盖范围。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 32 位浮点操作在写回寄存器文件前的最终结果打包阶段。
把 NaN-boxing 改成对更宽目的寄存器的普通低 32 位赋值。
保持 FP 异常标志和 32 位算术数据通路不变。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: final F32 result packing on RV64 FPU paths
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复让各模块在 XLEN > 32 时输出 {32'hffffffff, result[31:0]}，从而把单精度结果正确 NaN-box 到 64 位寄存器。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复旧的 data_out 到 result 直接赋值，这样在 XLEN > 32 时高 32 位就不再被强制成全 1。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 64 位机器上的单精度浮点结果会变成错误封箱值，导致体系结构不一致和后续浮点解释错误。
evidence_for_injection: 三个受影响模块都只改了结果打包逻辑，没有改动算术核心。
修复明确只针对 XLEN > 32 场景，这把缺陷范围限定在 64 位写回格式化上。
notes: 若想构造更小的注入基准，可以只对其中一个模块施加该变异；原始提交则是同时修复三个模块。
